versions.changelog:
No changes detected for version 1.1.0.

- No file changes were made in this version.
- Functionality and documentation remain the same as the previous release.

- Removed documentation files: vibe-safe-harness-patch.md and vibe-safe.md.
- Added new documentation: README.md.
- No changes to skill logic; documentation files reorganized.

Initial release of vibe-safe: a security pre-flight protocol for AI coding agents.

- Introduces a multi-phase workflow: PLAN libraries, AUDIT dependencies, CERTIFY status, then CODE.
- Requires explicit secrets management policies and enforcement for all dependencies.
- Integrates CVE and maintenance checks using npm audit, pip-audit, OSV.dev, GitHub API, and deps.dev.
- Provides clear decision thresholds: AUTO-BLOCK, CONDITIONAL (user must approve), or CERTIFIED (safe to proceed).
- Supports ex-post (autonomous) and interactive audit/reporting modes.
- Certification status recorded in `stay_safe.md`; only audited libraries may be used in code.
